title: Engine Fuel and Control — Control Unit Cooling Duct and Bracket Provision for Standard 9

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the larger cooling duct and the revised mounting bracket that the standard 9 engine control unit requires, so that the unit and its software loads can be fitted as a separate activity.

sections.planning_reason: Two thirds of engine control unit removals in the 2022 and 2023 seasons were returned as no fault found, because the thirty second fault recording window closes before the maintenance crew can capture the event. The standard 9 unit records eight minutes, but the additional memory needs more cooling than the existing duct provides and the unit is heavier than the existing bracket is qualified for. This bulletin installs the provision so that the unit change is not held up behind duct and bracket work at the engine.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin installs the larger inlet cooling duct and the revised mounting bracket for the standard 9 engine control unit, and renews the anchor nuts and grommets at the mounting face. The existing control unit is refitted on the new bracket and continues to operate unchanged. No software is loaded by this bulletin.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the engine is cool and that the aircraft is not powered. Open the fan cowl and the pylon lower fairing to reach zones 433, 412 and 483. Disconnect and remove the existing control unit at FIN 25EF following task AMM-Z-73-20-11-000-041-A. Remove the existing cooling duct. Install the duct D7320110360398 and check that the inlet is clear and correctly oriented. Remove the existing mounting bracket and install the bracket INN739616-21 with the anchor nuts LN953956K3. Install the grommets AES641639-8C at every harness penetration in the mounting face. Check the clearance to the tube assembly at FIN 342EF and to the clamp at FIN 18EF. Refit the existing control unit on the new bracket and re-connect the harness. Do an engine ground run and confirm that the control unit reports no new fault. Repeat for the second engine.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable per engine to ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 Evo model aircraft delivered before the standard 9 production cut-in. The provision may be embodied whether or not the operator intends to fit the standard 9 unit, and there is no penalty in leaving the existing unit on the new bracket indefinitely.
sections.material_note: Kit K7320-1006-01 covers one engine and contains the duct, the bracket, the anchor nut set and the grommet set. Two kits are required per aircraft. The bracket is a fourteen week item.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, or before the standard 9 unit is fitted, whichever occurs first.

revision_history.reason: Grommet part number corrected and the duct orientation clarified in step 5
Effectivity extended to PYR-1127G and PYR-1133G powered aircraft and the anchor nut quantity corrected
